pages.text: Supplies the network's configured power costs.$(br2)It consumes configured resources; it does not generate power.

pages.title: Attach a supply
pages.text: When your pack enables upkeep, place the node against a compatible external supply and wand-link it to the network.$(br2)The node draws from that attached supply. FE is the default payment resource; packs can choose fuel or optional mod resources.$(br2)Insufficient supply pauses charged routing and crafting.
